metadata.description: Agent skills that generate the operator-attested ConfigMaps consumed by trivy-plugin-vdr for FedRAMP VDR/VER: cluster dataflow capture and compositional CR/IR/AR decision-trace attestations.

plugins.name: trivy-plugin-vdr-skills
plugins.description: Two skills for FedRAMP VDR/VER evidence generation with trivy-plugin-vdr: capture-dataflow analyzes NetworkPolicies, service-mesh authorization resources, optional Hubble/mesh flow exports, and workload env/Secret/ConfigMap declarations to produce the vdr-dataflow ConfigMap and diagrams; generate-vdr-configmap interviews the operator for Certification Class, agency scope, and compositional disclosure/change/dependency attestations, then produces the vdr-fedramp scoring ConfigMap. Artifacts stay local for operator review; the skills never modify the cluster.
